```yaml
name: Regenerate Sonar API Spec Cache

on:
  schedule:
    # Daily at 06:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  regenerate-sonar-api-spec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'
          cache-dependency-path: docusaurus/pnpm-lock.yaml

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: |
          npm install -g pnpm@9.4.0

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: docusaurus
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Authenticate as octavia-bot
        id: auth
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v2
        with:
          owner: "airbytehq"
          repositories: "airbyte"
          app-id: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Fetch and regenerate Sonar API spec
        working-directory: docusaurus
        run: |
          node ../poe-tasks/prepare-embedded-api-spec.js
          pnpm prettier --write openapi.json

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check_changes
        working-directory: docusaurus
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "no_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "no_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.no_changes == 'false'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ steps.auth.outputs.token }}
          commit-message: "chore: auto-update Sonar API spec\n\nAutomatically updated the Sonar API specification from upstream source."
          branch: "auto/sonar-api-spec-update"
          title: "chore: auto-update Sonar API spec"
          body: |
            This PR was automatically created to update the Sonar API specification.
            
            ### Auto-generated changes
            - Updated Sonar API spec from https://airbyte-sonar-prod.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/openapi/latest/app.json
            - Formatted spec with Prettier
            
            ### Labels
            - auto-merge
            - autogenerated
            - documentation
          labels: |
            auto-merge
            autogenerated
            documentation
          delete-branch: true
```
